summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Ltd reporting its Q1 2026 earnings results. It includes a press release, financial statements, and an earnings call presentation. The release highlights net income of $62.6M, a quarterly dividend of $0.50/share, and share repurchases. While it mentions the closing of a previously announced acquisition of Rawlinson Hunter Guernsey on April 15, 2026, the filing itself is a routine earnings report, not an announcement of a new special situation. The acquisition was already announced in February 2026. Thus, this filing does not trigger a special-situation classification.
